verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for a SaaS integration platform like Composio, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a way to export your data (connected accounts, credentials, configurations, trigger history) in open formats, or any offboarding path. The public OpenAPI spec and CLI are developer building blocks, not a documented export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
